generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
network_unreachable: The local backend is not reachable. Start the API and try again.
request_failed: The request could not be completed.
validation_error: The information provided is not valid.
project_not_found: This project could not be found.
project_storage_missing: The project folder is missing. Restore it from a backup or remove the project.
unsupported_file_type: That file type isn’t supported yet. Use JPG, PNG, WEBP, BMP, TIFF or PDF.
image_unreadable: One of the images could not be read.
pdf_unavailable: PDF support is not installed on this device.
pdf_unreadable: The PDF file could not be read.
pdf_encrypted: Password-protected PDFs are not supported. Remove the password first.
pdf_empty: The PDF does not contain any pages.
pdf_too_many_pages: The PDF has too many pages for one import. Split it and try again.
pdf_page_render_failed: One of the PDF pages could not be rendered.
file_too_large: The file is larger than the current import limit.
too_many_files: Too many files were selected for one batch.
invalid_page_order: The new page order was invalid. Nothing was changed.
page_not_found: This page could not be found.
asset_not_found: The image file could not be found.
asset_file_missing: The image file is missing from the project folder.
ocr_unavailable: A local OCR engine is not available. Install Tesseract and try again.
ocr_language_unavailable: The selected OCR language data is not installed.
ocr_page_has_no_source: This page has no image to process.
ocr_run_not_found: The OCR result could not be found.
ocr_block_not_found: That OCR text block could not be found.
ocr_not_ready: OCR has not finished for this page yet.
ocr_image_unreadable: The page image could not be prepared for OCR.
ocr_timeout: OCR timed out. Try a smaller page or increase the OCR timeout.
ocr_failed: OCR could not read this page. Check the local engine and try again.
ocr_worker_unavailable: The local OCR worker is not available.
ocr_stale: The page changed after OCR. Run OCR again before using this text.
ocr_block_empty: This OCR text block has no text to review.
import_job_not_found: This import job could not be found.
import_not_running: This import has already finished and cannot be cancelled.
import_failed: The import could not be completed. Check the selected files and try again.
import_interrupted: The import was interrupted before it finished. Pages that were already saved have been kept.
import_worker_unavailable: The local import worker is not available. Restart the app and try again.
ai_unreachable: The local AI server is not reachable. Start it and check the URL in Settings.
ai_timeout: The local AI server did not answer in time. It may still be loading the model.
ai_http_error: The local AI server returned an error. Check its log and the configured URL.
ai_invalid_response: The local AI server replied in an unexpected format. Check that it is Ollama or OpenAI-compatible.
ai_not_configured: Choose a local AI model in Settings before using AI assistance.
ai_vision_not_configured: Choose a vision model in Settings before asking AI to analyse a page image.
ai_page_image_missing: This page image is not available for AI analysis. Try reopening the page or re-importing it.
ai_empty_response: The local AI server returned no text. The OCR text was left unchanged.
ai_text_too_long: This text is too long for one AI request. Split it or review it manually.
ai_remote_not_allowed: This AI server is not on localhost. Enable remote AI consent in Settings before sending text to it.
ai_request_limit_reached: The AI request limit for the last 24 hours has been reached. Change the limit in Settings or try again later.
ai_suggestion_not_found: This AI proposal could not be found.
ai_suggestion_not_pending: This AI proposal was already accepted or rejected.
ai_suggestion_stale: The OCR text changed after this proposal was created. Request a new proposal.
invalid_ai_settings: The local AI settings are not valid. Check the URL and model.
invalid_ai_suggestion_status: That proposal decision is not valid.
not_found: The requested item could not be found.
internal_error: The local backend encountered an unexpected error.
